text: dsh-niu-lai 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的《牛来》音效插件。它在浏览器端监听会话快照，新用户消息播放“妈妈”，回合结束播放“牛来”，并通过设置页提供总开关、音量、试听、替换和恢复默认。音频由 Web Audio 播放，内置片段随包提供，用户自选音频和设置保存在浏览器中。适合希望为 DSH Web 会话加入轻量声音反馈的用户；不需要 API Key 或外部服务。

dsh-niu-lai adds meme sounds to DSH Web. It plays “妈妈” for new messages and “牛来” when a turn completes. The settings tab offers a toggle, volume, preview, custom clip replacement, and reset. Bundled clips use Web Audio; custom clips stay in browser storage. No API key or external service is needed.
想让 DSH Web 收到新消息时播一声提示音。
希望每当一个会话回合完成，就自动播放音效。
能不能给网页里的 agent 会话加上自定义声音反馈？
我想在设置页调节提示音音量并一键静音。
如何试听或更换会话消息和任务完成时的音频？
想避免打开历史会话或翻页时重复响提示音。
Play a sound when a new user message arrives in a web agent session.
I want an audio cue whenever a DSH task finishes.
dsh-niu-lai 的功能「message-sound」：用户发出新消息时，插件检测新增的 user 或 steering 节点并播放“妈妈”音效；首次载入和已有历史只用于建立基线。
dsh-niu-lai 的功能「completion-sound」：会话出现回合结束记录、定稿的助手消息或终止错误时，插件播放“牛来”音效，并按回合去重。
dsh-niu-lai 的功能「sound-settings」：设置页可开关音效、调节音量、试听片段、选择本地音频替换并恢复默认；修改立即保存在浏览器设置中。

dsh-niu-lai README · dsh-niu-lai 🐂🔊：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) Web plugin that brings the viral 《牛来》 movie meme to your agent sessions:

- **You send a message → the computer plays “妈妈”**
- **A task completes → the computer plays “牛来”**

All in-browser (Web Audio). No API keys, no external services, the clips ship embedded in the bundle.

dsh-niu-lai README · Install：```sh
dsh-niu-lai README · GitHub source (works today)：dsh plugin --profile web add github:jxwb125646/dsh-niu-lai

dsh-niu-lai README · npm (once published)：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-niu-lai
```

Then restart `dsh web` and refresh the page.

dsh-niu-lai README · Configure：Open **Settings → Plugins → 牛来音效** (Niu Lai sounds):

- master on/off switch and volume slider
- per-clip **preview**, **replace** (pick any local audio file — stored in your browser, survives restarts), and **reset to default**

dsh-niu-lai README · How it works：The browser half watches every session's conversation snapshot:

- a new `user`/`steering` message node → plays the *Mama* clip
- a turn ends (finalized assistant message or terminal turn error) → plays the *Niu Lai* clip

Anti-spam guards: session open/history pagination/reconnect never trigger; each turn sounds once; nothing plays while a session is still loading. One clip at a time — a new sound interrupts the one still playing, so a fast reply's “牛来” cuts off a lingering “妈妈”.
dsh-niu-lai README · How it works：Two notes: browsers require one click/keypress before audio unlocks (sending a message counts); every open page tab plays its own copy.

dsh-niu-lai README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-niu-lai
```

dsh-niu-lai README · Building from source：The committed `lib/` is prebuilt against dsh 0.1.x. To rebuild:

```sh
npm install
npm run embed-audio   # assets/*.mp3 → src/client/assets.ts (base64 data URLs)
npm run build         # tsdown → lib/host.js + lib/client.js
```

The tsdown preset is vendored in `scripts/vendor/` (from `packages/client/tsdown.client.ts` in the dsh repo) so the build needs no dsh checkout.

dsh-niu-lai README · Audio attribution：The two default clips are the viral “妈妈” cow sound and “牛来” phrase from the movie 《牛来》.
